messages:
kevin: Hey folks — pushed PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/981, it's a small change to the batching/KV cache hotpath. Short summary: 1) move KV lookup earlier to avoid cache miss penalty during batching, 2) add a harmless fallback if tile size differs, 3) tweak attention kernel tiling flag default.

kevin: Perf on internal CI: ~+12% tokens/sec on 2xA100 load test, p50 latency roughly the same. Added unit + integration tests. Requesting review/approval before the afternoon merge window.

maria: PTAL — curious about the fallback. If kernel tiling mismatch happens, does it force single-threaded fallback or use existing tile mapper?

kevin: Good q — fallback uses existing tile mapper with a safe slow path; added comment in code and a flag `--force-safe-tiling` for manual testing. See snippet in PR:

`````
if (!tile_compat) {
  // use safe mapper to avoid OOB
  mapper = safe_tile_mapper();
}
`````

aj: Left a tiny comment about adding a neg test for the tile mismatch. Can that be added quickly? Otherwise LGTM from perf POV.

lucy: I can review the kernel diffs in ~45m. If CI stays green and the unit test is added, I can approve before the 3pm merge window.

sre-bot: CI status: linux-unit-tests: passing, integration-load: running (ETA ~12m), flake8: passing

kevin: Thanks — I'll add the neg test now and push. If all green, aim to merge at 14:50 PT. Appreciated! :rocket:

lucy: Sounds good, will watch the run and ping on approval.

kevin: One more note — this change touches the live-compatible model variant routing; tagging @maria since it affects fallback semantics.

maria: Saw the tag, will skim after lunch. If anything weird we can rollback the flag quickly.

kevin: Great, thanks team.
